judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale:
The 'next' link of the news-list pagination: », inside
, after the links 'Page 2' and 'Page 3' (the word 'Page' is screen-reader-only text). Against the finding: the Pagination landmark and the page-number siblings are programmatic context, and '»' conventionally means next, so the claim that nothing around it helps is overstated. For it: a nav label is not among the definition's examples of link context (sentence, paragraph, list item, table cell), screen readers voice the glyph as 'right double angle bracket', and '»' can also mean 'last'. Competent auditors would disagree.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The h2 '01/11/2026' is the blue date pill of the 1st-phase card. It comes right after the heading 'MÚLTIPLA ESCOLHA' (under '1ª FASE'), and below it are '80 QUESTÕES' and the subject list. In an exam schedule the date is what the block is about: the multiple-choice exam on that day. 2.4.6 asks that headings describe topic or purpose, not that each one stand alone without the heading before it. Whether a date pill should be a heading at all is a 1.3.1 matter, not 2.4.6. The model had the neighbouring headings and judged wrongly.
